name: decimen-optical-transfer
description: Offline file and text transfer using fountain-coded animated QR codes — screen to camera, no network.

scripts.build:standalone: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-standalone',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && vite build --mode standalone-send && vite build --mode standalone-receive
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:standalone
scripts.desktop:kylin: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux deb --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
